notes.title: 0.872 Version Released!
notes.notes:
Firstly, please accept my apologies.
I misplaced a number in easy mode so level 1-1 became even harder than hard mode. 
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31164778/e0e3c4645b46f45cfc9a4769b58d1c757d329103.gif[/img]
But I've fixed it.

And here's a detailed list changed in 0.872 version.

- Brand new training level. Please have a try and tell me what do you think.
- Now Escape key opens menu during gameplay.
- A fast game over mode has been added. Now you can skip the game over screen and restart from the last checkpoint immediately.
- Soundtracks update.
- Added an option to the pause screen to allow player restart game from the last checkpoint.
- Fixed a bug where sometimes the game freezes at the game clear screen.
- Fixed a bug that turrets receiving damage from an unknown source.
- Fixed a configuration of level 1-1 in easy mode. (oops)

Demo version got fixed too.

Cheer!
